title: 住宅の門柱
description: 戸建て住宅の門の脇に立つ、機能門柱です。石調タイル張りの柱と目地、スレートの笠木、無地の表札、郵便受けの投函口とフラップ、カメラ付きインターホン、点灯する門灯、背面の宅配ボックスを造形しています。表札は無地で、住所・氏名・番地などの文字、インターホンの機能、配線は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.560 × 1.410 × 0.730 m、1,612三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A functional gate pillar beside a detached house entrance. It models the stone-tiled pillar with joints, slate cap, a blank house name plate, a mail slot with flap, a camera intercom, a lit porch lamp and a rear parcel delivery box. The name plate is blank: no address, family name or house number; intercom function and wiring are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.560 × 1.410 × 0.730 m; 1,612 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
